scope: Retrospective calibration resampling sensitivity conditional on existing scores, fitted predictors/heads, reporting cap and T. No evaluation outcomes read. No model fitting. Not new confirmation, population risk control, or true model uncertainty.

m5.cap_rule: Read pre-existing FROZEN cap and keep fixed in every replicate.
m5.cluster: item, every store and all 63 calibration days retained; same item multiplicities in A and B
m5.score_scale: Original policy_audit.scores, including demand denominator w/T

bike.cluster: calendar day, all recorded hours retained; labels read only from dteday field of existing bike.zip and existing SPLITS cal indices
bike.score_scale: Original nonretail/run.py: demand denominator w; mixed denominator .25+.75*w/T

fixed_candidates.thresholds: Fixed to pre-existing FROZEN thresholds. Reevaluate positive mass, row floor and design cap in every calibration window. Choose among eligible frozen candidates. No threshold refit.

full_procedure.refit: Within each bootstrap resample redesign the largest observed whole-tie threshold for all five fixed rankings, then maximize minimum window coverage among feasible candidates. Fits, score values, cap and T remain fixed. Only score ties occurring in the resample are candidate thresholds. Positive infinity allowed only via explicit accept-all.
full_procedure.risk_rules: Reuse each dataset original design cap, floor, and explicit accept-all branch.
full_procedure.draw_count: Fixed before analysis; do not change in response to outcomes.

selection.criterion: Maximum minimum-window case or exposure coverage; declared method order breaks exact ties.

outputs: Every candidate calibration risk, coverage, eligibility, exact winner/runner-up margins
Every candidate selection/eligibility frequency, no-choice frequency, winner margin quantiles
Ratio minus exposure-descending and Ratio minus Mixed utility margin distributions, with joint-eligibility counts
Full raw replicate arrays and count matrices
all-one multiplicities reproduce original FROZEN thresholds and choices; weighted toy agrees with literal replicated samples using existing largest_threshold
limitations: Cluster bootstrap ignores shared store/calendar shocks for M5 and cross-day dependence for Bike. Fixed-candidate screening at boundary can create no-choice frequency. Full-procedure frequencies are descriptive algorithm sensitivity, not probability of a genuinely optimal policy.
